notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
Hollow Space 1.2.0 Update – Change Log
New Features and Content

 Location Changes:

 New cockpit design in the starting location of Omega Squadron.

 New Weapon Items:

 Fragmentation grenades.
 Molotov cocktails.
 Rocket launchers.

 New Mechanic:

 The scanner is back – use it to find items related to the current mission.


Gameplay Changes

 New obstacles on the space station that can affect the player's health.

Visual and Audio Improvements

 Improved animations for each weapon.
 Added new and enhanced old visual and sound effects.
 Improved post-processing effects.

Performance Improvements

 Optimized the game’s performance to improve its smoothness.

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
Patch Notes for Hollow Space v1.1.0
[previewyoutube=NyI4vt8CQ30;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re excited to announce the release of update v1.1.0, which brings several major features and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

1. Bot Gameplay
[olist]
 You can now play Hollow Space with AI-controlled bots.
 Perfect for solo players or those looking to sharpen their skills without needing a full lobby of players.
[/olist]

2. Voice Chat Integration
[olist]
 In-game Voice Chat has been added, allowing players to communicate directly with teammates.
 Available in proximity chat format or team-based channels, adding a layer of strategy and immersion.
[/olist]

3. New Location: Yellow Station
[olist]
 Explore Yellow Station, a fresh addition to the space station roster.
 Features unique layouts, atmospheric lighting, and hidden pathways designed to challenge both crew members and mutants.
 This location brings new strategic opportunities for both factions to gain an edge in gameplay.
[/olist]

4. Language Support
[olist]
 The game now includes support for six additional languages: Polish, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, French, and Italian.
 Players can enjoy menus, subtitles, and text dialogues fully localized in their preferred language.
 This update makes Hollow Space more accessible to a wider global audience.
 We hope you enjoy these new features and enhancements. Keep sending us your feedback as we continue to improve Hollow Space. See you in the void!
[/olist]
